context._comment_checkSecretUsage: Off deliberately: the DB password is passed to the Lambdas as an environment variable. See the reasoning in lib/snapurl-stack.ts.
context._comment_natStrategy: Pinned default (issue #348). A deploy that omits -c natStrategy must NOT fall back to a topology that kills Lambda egress. 'instance' is the ~$6/mo t4g.micro NAT with full IPv4 egress. deploy.sh still requires NAT_STRATEGY explicitly; this is the belt-and-suspenders floor for a raw `cdk deploy`. Non-secret.
context._comment_natAmiIds: NAT instance AMI pinned per region (AL2023 arm64, public Amazon AMI ids, non-secret). Unpinned, every deploy after an AL2023 release replaced the NAT instance; one such replacement failed its iptables setup and took the API down. A new id here replaces the instance on the next deploy, so bump it on purpose, and before the pinned image's deprecation date.
